description: NL -> BeingDB DSL evaluation over the Rewind pack (beingdb-wasm export). Supported items carry a trusted reference query; 'key' lists the reference variables that make up the answer (generated queries may project extra variables). 'orderBy' requires the generated rows to follow the same order on that variable. Unsupported items have no predicate (or DSL feature) that can express them.

items.question: Which works were created in 1979?
items.reference:
find Work
where
  year_created(Work, @1979)

items.question: List all works and the people who created them.
items.reference:
find Work, Artist
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)

items.question: Which artists were interviewed for Rewind?
items.reference:
find Artist
where
  interviewed_artist(Artist)

items.question: Who funded Peter Donebauer?
items.reference:
find Funder
where
  funded_by(peter_donebauer, Funder)

items.question: Where was Elsa Stansfield educated?
items.reference:
find School
where
  educated_at(elsa_stansfield, School)

items.question: Which works did Judith Goddard create?
items.reference:
find Work
where
  created_by(Work, judith_goddard)

items.question: Which works are in the collection of the Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam?
items.reference:
find Work
where
  in_collection(Work, stedelijk_museum_amsterdam)

items.question: Who made the soundtrack for Cultural Quarter?
items.reference:
find Person
where
  soundtrack_by(cultural_quarter, Person)

items.question: What has the Arts Council funded?
items.reference:
find Thing
where
  funded_by(Thing, arts_council)

items.question: List all exhibitions.
items.reference:
find Exhibition
where
  exhibition(Exhibition)

items.question: Where did Kevin Atherton perform?
items.reference:
find Venue
where
  performed_at(kevin_atherton, Venue)

items.question: Who was employed by the BBC?
items.reference:
find Person
where
  employed_by(Person, bbc)

items.question: Who influenced Peter Donebauer?
items.reference:
find Influence
where
  influenced_by(peter_donebauer, Influence)

items.question: Who did David Critchley collaborate with?
items.reference:
find Other
where
  collaborated_with(david_critchley, Other)

items.question: What was exhibited at the Tate?
items.reference:
find Work
where
  exhibited_at(Work, tate)

items.question: Who curated Scratch Video Volume 1?
items.reference:
find Curator
where
  curated_by(scratch_video_volume_1, Curator)

items.question: Which works were made at Maidstone College?
items.reference:
find Work
where
  made_at(Work, maidstone_college)

items.question: Who collaborated with Delia Derbyshire?
items.reference:
find Person
where
  collaborated_with(Person, delia_derbyshire)

items.question: Which artists created works between 1975 and 1980?
items.reference:
find Artist, Work, Y
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  year_created(Work, Y)
  Y between @1975 and @1980

items.question: Which works were created after 1980, and by whom?
items.reference:
find Work, Artist
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  year_created(Work, Y)
  Y > @1980

items.question: Show works, their creators and their year, ordered by year.
items.reference:
find Work, Artist, Year
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  year_created(Work, Year)
order by Year ascending

items.question: Which works by Madelon Hooykaas were exhibited, and where?
items.reference:
find Work, Venue
where
  created_by(Work, madelon_hooykaas)
  exhibited_at(Work, Venue)

items.question: Which interviewed artists were funded by the Arts Council?
items.reference:
find Artist
where
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  funded_by(Artist, arts_council)

items.question: Where were the interviewed artists educated?
items.reference:
find Artist, School
where
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  educated_at(Artist, School)

items.question: Which works by George Barber have a recorded creation year?
items.reference:
find Work, Year
where
  created_by(Work, george_barber)
  year_created(Work, Year)

items.question: Which artists created works that were exhibited at the Serpentine Gallery?
items.reference:
find Artist, Work
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  exhibited_at(Work, serpentine_gallery)

items.question: Which works by Elsa Stansfield were created in the 1980s?
items.reference:
find Work
where
  created_by(Work, elsa_stansfield)
  year_created(Work, Y)
  Y between @1980 and @1989

items.question: Which works last longer than 10 minutes?
items.reference:
find Work, Minutes
where
  duration_minutes(Work, Minutes)
  Minutes > 10

items.question: Which works were created before 1975, and in what year?
items.reference:
find Work, Year
where
  year_created(Work, Year)
  Year < @1975

items.question: List the places where Kevin Atherton exhibited, in alphabetical order.
items.reference:
find Venue
where
  exhibited_at(kevin_atherton, Venue)
order by Venue ascending

items.question: What is the source URL of the interview with Mike Stubbs?
items.reference:
find Url
where
  interviewee(Doc, mike_stubbs)
  source_url(Doc, Url)

items.question: Who created the works that Channel 4 funded?
items.reference:
find Work, Artist
where
  funded_by(Work, channel_4)
  created_by(Work, Artist)

items.question: Which interviewed artists were not funded by the Arts Council?
items.reference:
find Artist
where
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  not
    funded_by(Artist, arts_council)

items.question: List every interviewed artist with the works they created, keeping artists who have no works.
items.reference:
find Artist, Work
where
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  optional
    created_by(Work, Artist)

items.question: Which pairs of different people created the same work, and which work?
items.reference:
find Work, A, B
where
  created_by(Work, A)
  created_by(Work, B)
  A != B

items.question: Which works created before 1980 have no recorded exhibition?
items.reference:
find Work
where
  year_created(Work, Y)
  Y < @1980
  not
    exhibited_at(Work, _)

items.question: Which works were created by either Elsa Stansfield or Madelon Hooykaas?
items.reference:
find Work
where
  either
    created_by(Work, elsa_stansfield)
  or
    created_by(Work, madelon_hooykaas)

items.question: Which works exhibited at the Tate were created by an interviewed artist?
items.reference:
find Work, Artist
where
  exhibited_at(Work, tate)
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  interviewed_artist(Artist)

items.question: Which exhibitions took place in Paris?
items.reason: No predicate links exhibitions to the city they were held in (held_at/venue_in_area have no Paris facts; exhibited_at(_, paris) is empty).

items.question: What nationality is Rose Garrard?
How many works did George Barber create?
What is the average duration of the works?
Which works sold for more than 1000 pounds?
When was Kevin Atherton born?
items.reason: No birth date predicate (born_in is a place, and only for George Barber).

items.question: Which artists died before 2000?
What is Judith Goddard's email address?
Which works are about climate change?
What is the capital of France?
What are the dimensions of the Spout Sculpture?
Which artist has made the most works?
items.reason: Needs counting and ranking, which the DSL does not have.
